bic_trace_step.reason: The function usbip_pack_ret_submit() in the unpack path (else block, line 532) unconditionally overwrites urb->number_of_packets with rpdu->number_of_packets from the network PDU without any validation: 'urb->number_of_packets = rpdu->number_of_packets;'. This allows an attacker to specify an arbitrarily large number of packets, leading to out-of-bounds access when iterating over urb->iso_frame_desc[].
